answer_1.quote: We also utilize LLMs for two rewriting tasks. ... Recipe Title Generation Task ... Recipe Title Cultural Adaption Task ...

answer_2.quote: We first use reference-based automatic metrics. ... we use three overlap-based metrics: BLEU, ChrF, ROUGE-L and one representation-based metric: BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: The same annotators as in Section 5.2 perform manual evaluation on four criteria in cross-cultural recipes adaptation ...
answer_4.guideline: Rate on a 7-point scale for four criteria: Grammar, Consistency, Preservation, and Cultural Appropriateness.
